clue.text: Came across old shot of just the top of a face

definitions.text: of just the top of a face

parts.note: to come across someone is to have met them
a shot is a photograph, a pic

explanation.surface: Someone happened upon a vintage photo cropped to show only a forehead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' looks like part of the description of the photo, but it supplies PIC on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective is anatomical, describing the forehead, the region at the very top of the face.

clue.text: Fail to include a line in service book

parts.note: to miss is to leave out

clue.text: Excuse pressure concerning words used for speech

re means about, concerning

clue.text: Australian bird dog walked off with in piece of cloth

clue.text: Funny reason one can't get into the theatre for audition?

explanation.walkthrough: 'Audition' looks like a theatre tryout, which fits the surface, but here it means a hearing: PLAY FULL spoken aloud sounds like the answer.

clue.text: Flyer exercises intelligence

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises

clue.text: Old needing to bend when accepting seat mostly

clue.text: Female with whip showing off

clue.text: Complained about me interrupting dental working

clue.text: Racer frantic in sailing dinghy for bird repellent

clue.text: Cleaner beginning to move ornament

clue.text: More than enough length in inside of camper

clue.text: Get corn nicely developed in process vital for growth

clue.text: Like melodious chorus of Cambridge that is welcoming learner

clue.text: Leaping to pass over computer query?

clue.text: Bussing company nearly employing one from another branch that's close

clue.text: Burning lust in partially vacated part of eastern Europe

clue.text: Argue over a name for member of the rose family

clue.text: Boleyn, Henry's second to go, treated not in this way!
